children: Russia's production of petroleum products and coke dropped 17.8% year-on-year in August, easing from an earlier decline, according to Rosstat data published on Wednesday.
Output fell by 1.9% in August from July, according to Rosstat
It did not provide absolute numbers for output.
The decline eased from a 19.3% year-on-year drop in July.
Output in January - August fell by 10.3% compared with January to July 2025, according to Rosstat data.
Fuel production in Russia is declining amid Ukrainian drone attacks on oil refineries.
